_comment: Triage of the corpus's guard failures (RFC 0035, section 11), checked by
scripts/corpus-gate.py. `guardFailures` lists the guard failures of a test suite that are true
bugs of the project: {config, file, line, verdict, note, kind (optional, a run-time report
kind)}, verdict always "true" and note the source evidence. A report at such a site is not
counted as a trap; an entry no run names is reported as stale without failing. A false trap
is never triaged: it is a bug in WeaveC.
